labeller_note: Read only batch-core.json, vocabulary.md, the 13 workflow YAMLs and workflow_registry.py (claim-support section). For each prompt I quoted the shortest words naming each wanted result and listed every PRODUCES id that gives it as worded, respecting granularity (per-sample vs one cohort network), regulator kind (TF-only requests exclude PUMA/LIONESS-PUMA) and sign. Results described by type list all entries of that type; results referred to only through a named method ('Run OTTER', 'the network it returns') list that method's entry, with a 'why'. Vague network wording ('a network analysis', 'how genes are connected') lists every network entry; wording with no result type ('tell me what you find', 'which should I run') gets no result and a note. When a prompt states two readings, each reading is a separate result. Purposes the user says they will do later ('so I can later compare') are not results but are noted. Settings map to the workflow the phrase concerns; GIRAFFE's optimizer words are unregistered because GIRAFFE has no controls. Omics-layer slot numbers are positional (first-named layer = omics_layer_1; a non-expression layer next to expression = omics_layer_2); miRNA-target priors map to motif_file and miRNA ID lists to mirna_file. Source links are given where the prompt ties a result to named data ('run X on file', 'built from', 'from').
